description: Change how the workspace handles one Inbox conversation: mark it read or unread, archive or reopen it, snooze it until a time (at most 90 days out), or assign it to a teammate, who is notified. Nothing is sent to the other person and nothing changes on the platform. Send at least one field. The Inbox is part of the Pro and Business plans; on other plans, or before it is available to the account, the call is refused with a message saying so. Use this when the user wants to mark a conversation read or unread, archive or reopen it, snooze it, or assign it to a teammate.

assignedUserId.description: A workspace member's user id; null unassigns.

read.description: true marks it read, false unread.

snoozedUntil.description: ISO timestamp in the future to snooze until; null unsnoozes.

status.description: archived archives it, open reopens it. Either clears a snooze.

name: update_conversation
title: Update Inbox conversation
